standalone tracing retains the verified engine and all bundled fonts
isolated production server starts on loopback
app exposes the sample download without a prefetched render

unknown invoice IDs return a private JSON error
unsupported writes are rejected by the route

scope: Public npm 0.5.1 / engine 2.5.24; 17 isolated production-route checks on Linux Node 22/24 and Windows Node 24, matching sample PDF bytes, plus actual local Chrome downloads at desktop and narrow widths. No application authorization, hosted-capacity or PDF standards claim.
